original_card.acceptance_gate: Demonstrate independence, source binding, positive cases and semantic failure controls. Name the existing checks and the missing coverage. More digits or another equivalent evaluation of an unchanged root is not by itself new verification coverage.

original_card.first_experiment: Independently recount one changed emitted word and its complete caller, importing no constructor or pricing engine. Include target losses, owned lifetimes, native orientation and extra charges. Check existing #5633/#5708/#5717/#5719 coverage to avoid duplicate audits and preserve its exact head.
